hunks.baseline: Because they lived closer to death than anyone, they’d even coined a grand term like a life-and-death duel, trying to make their own uncertain end sound a little more solemn.
hunks.sol: They lived closer to death than anyone, so they’d even coined a grand term like *life-and-death duel*, trying to make their own uncertain end sound a little more solemn.

hunks.baseline: But at some point, I realized that no matter how many fancy words the world had to offer, or how many valorous titles people bestowed on one another, the nature of it never changed.
hunks.sol: But at some point, I realized that no matter how many flowery words people used, or how many valorous titles they bestowed on one another, the nature of it never changed.

hunks.baseline: One where each person gave everything they had to bring down the opponent in front of them, driven by their own cause, circumstances, or selfish feelings.
hunks.sol: Each person gave everything they had to bring down the opponent in front of them, driven by their own cause, circumstances, or private feelings.

hunks.baseline: A simple, straightforward process in which the one who was even half a step faster, ten geun stronger, and far more vicious and cunning won.
hunks.sol: A simple, straightforward process: the one who was even half a step faster, ten geun stronger, and far more ruthless and calculating won.

hunks.baseline: I knew the gap between my opponent and me, and what the best I could do right now was.
hunks.sol: I knew how wide the gap was between my opponent and me. I knew the best I could do right now.

hunks.baseline: Watching the Blood Lord cross a dozen or so jang through the slowed world, I muttered to myself.
hunks.sol: I watched the Blood Lord cross a dozen or so jang through the slowed world, and the thought came to me.

hunks.baseline: Regret over this choice? Fear of death?
hunks.sol: Did I regret this choice? Was I afraid of dying?

hunks.baseline: To be exact, there wasn’t enough time to come up with an answer.
hunks.sol: More precisely, I didn’t have enough time to answer.

hunks.baseline: Even in the sluggish flow of time, the Blood Lord moved like a flash of light—and I was definitely slower.
hunks.sol: Even in the sluggish flow of time, the Blood Lord moved like a flash of light—and I was slower.

hunks.baseline: No. Right now, there was a gap of more than a full step between us, one I could never close. It stood like an iron wall.
hunks.sol: No. At least a full step stood between us now, a gap I could never close. It was an iron wall.

hunks.baseline: So, in the end, there was nothing else I could do.
hunks.sol: So there was nothing else I could do.

hunks.baseline: I could only charge at him like a moth.
hunks.sol: I could only charge like a moth.

hunks.baseline: Before that torch, reeking of blood, swallowed everyone, I had to put it out with one last, all-out beat of my wings.
hunks.sol: Before that torch, reeking of blood, swallowed everyone, I had to put it out with one last beat of my wings, giving it everything I had.

hunks.baseline: I was hot, as if I’d become a fire dragon myself. If I opened my mouth and roared, it felt like lava would pour out.
hunks.sol: I was so hot I felt as if I’d become a fire dragon myself. If I opened my mouth and roared, lava might pour out.

hunks.baseline: I had only one chance to spew out that lava.
hunks.sol: I had only one chance to let that lava loose.

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t my first time, but it was all but certain to be my last.
hunks.sol: It wouldn’t be my first time, but it was all but certain to be my last.

hunks.baseline: Just as the System warning chime that suddenly pierced my ears in this very moment seemed to say.
hunks.sol: The System warning chime that suddenly pierced my ears seemed to say as much.

hunks.baseline: It stretched out into a long ringing in my ears, following the slowed passage of time. It sounded like the flatline of a heart monitor announcing a patient’s cardiac arrest. That wasn’t an exaggeration.
hunks.sol: Slowed along with the passage of time, it stretched into a long ringing, like the flatline of a heart monitor announcing a patient’s cardiac arrest. That hardly seemed an exaggeration.

hunks.baseline: This colossal lava, boiling up from deep within me, held enough destructive power to turn even me to ash.
hunks.sol: The colossal mass of lava boiling up from deep within me held enough destructive power to turn even me to ash.

hunks.baseline: Heat warped the space as it slowly surged outward.
hunks.sol: Heat slowly surged outward, warping the space around me.

hunks.baseline: Flames that had seared my Lower Dantian and Middle Dantian, hundreds of acupoints, and the Eight Extraordinary Meridians layered over the spearhead.
hunks.sol: Flames that had seared my Lower Dantian, Middle Dantian, hundreds of acupoints, and Eight Extraordinary Meridians layered themselves over the spearhead.

hunks.baseline: For my one and only, final chance.
hunks.sol: All for one final chance.

hunks.baseline: *This is all I’ve got. The only way to bring him down.*
hunks.sol: *This is it. The only way to bring him down.*

hunks.baseline: And One Annihilation had grown just as much—powerful enough to devour even its wielder’s life.
hunks.sol: One Annihilation had grown just as much—powerful enough to devour even its wielder’s life.

hunks.baseline: *Unlike last time, he won’t get back up now.*
hunks.sol: *Unlike last time, he won’t get back up.*

hunks.baseline: One blow to render even the Blood Lord’s terrifying recovery useless.
hunks.sol: One blow would render even the Blood Lord’s terrifying recovery useless.

hunks.baseline: The moment blue-black flames, which would turn his body and even his soul to ash in an instant, flickered along the spearhead of White Flame, drawn far back—
hunks.sol: Blue-black flames that would turn his body and even his soul to ash in an instant flickered along the spearhead of White Flame, drawn far back. And then—

hunks.baseline: I was the archer. My body was the bow, and the string was already drawn taut.
hunks.sol: I was the archer. My body was the bow, and the string was already drawn all the way back.

hunks.baseline: Then why, at the most important moment, was this inexplicable sense of wrongness suddenly coming over me?
hunks.sol: Then why, at the most important moment, had this inexplicable sense of wrongness come over me?

hunks.baseline: Or a flashback of my life, arriving with the sense that this was the end?
hunks.sol: Or my life flashing before my eyes as I sensed the end?

hunks.baseline: I was wrong.
hunks.sol: That wasn’t it.

hunks.baseline: This feeling coming over me now wasn’t like any of those I’d experienced several times before.
hunks.sol: This feeling was different from any of those I’d experienced before.

hunks.baseline: This was a warning.
hunks.sol: It was a warning.

hunks.baseline: A warning from the other me—the one that followed nothing but instinct.
hunks.sol: A signal from the other me—the one that followed nothing but instinct.

hunks.baseline: Time, held back until now, and every sound and sight around me came crashing down all at once, like a massive wave breaking through a dam.
hunks.sol: Time, held back until now, came crashing down. Every sound and sight around me followed, like a massive wave breaking through a dam.

hunks.baseline: And with it came a blurred afterimage, flashing between the Blood Lord and me as we shot toward each other.
hunks.sol: Through it all, a blurred afterimage flashed between the Blood Lord and me as we shot toward each other.

hunks.baseline: A fierce whistle split the wind and rain, shooting from an unseen blind spot.
hunks.sol: From outside my field of vision came a fierce whistle, cutting through the wind and rain.

hunks.baseline: I realized too late that it was there—the figure clad from head to toe in pitch-black armor. No, *it*.
hunks.sol: I realized too late that something was there, clad from head to toe in pitch-black armor. Someone—no, *something*.

hunks.baseline: I felt the blood in my body turn cold.
hunks.sol: The blood in my body turned cold.

hunks.baseline: As if he wouldn’t allow even the smallest variable.
hunks.sol: He meant to leave no room for even the smallest variable.

hunks.baseline: Realizing there were no more choices, I let out the curse I’d been holding back and thrust my spear—the weight of my past and future resting on its tip.
hunks.sol: With no choices left, I spat out the curse I’d been holding back and thrust my spear forward. My entire past and future rested on its tip.

hunks.baseline: The space warped.
hunks.sol: Space warped.

hunks.baseline: The fire dragon’s flames roared, flooding everything I could see in blue-black.
hunks.sol: The fire dragon’s flames let out a tremendous roar, flooding everything I could see in blue-black.

hunks.baseline: And at the last moment, as that dreadful heat was about to devour everything in its path, a streak of light swept past the Black Ghost like an apparition.
hunks.sol: At the last moment, as that dreadful heat was about to devour everything in its path, a streak of light swept past the Black Ghost like an apparition.

hunks.baseline: A tiny whistle—so faint I wouldn’t have heard it if my senses hadn’t been sharper than ever.
hunks.sol: A faint sound of air being cut—so faint I wouldn’t have heard it if my senses hadn’t been sharper than ever.

hunks.baseline: And it wasn’t an apparition or a hallucination.
hunks.sol: Neither the sight nor the sound was an illusion.

hunks.baseline: But even he, who’d endlessly turned over the final moments of the four Demon Lords and the Demon Empress who had fallen to Jin Taekyung, couldn’t help but feel certain now.
hunks.sol: But even he, who’d endlessly turned over the final moments of the four Demon Lords and the Demon Empress who had fallen to Jin Taekyung, couldn’t help feeling certain now.

hunks.baseline: The vile connection with that damned brat, who made him sick just to think about, ended here.
hunks.sol: His sickening history with that damned brat, who made him feel foul just to think about, ended here.

hunks.baseline: The plan was that perfect. It was as good as a success already.
hunks.sol: The plan was perfect. It was as good as done.

hunks.baseline: And so, the Blood Lord had no doubt that the strike he couldn’t begin to understand had grown terrifyingly powerful, too.
hunks.sol: And with him, that incomprehensible strike had surely grown terrifyingly powerful, too.

hunks.sol: Then a streak of light flew in from somewhere and swept past the Black Ghost that had moved between Jin Taekyung and the Blood Lord at his command.
